name: Shua
title: The Descendant of Judah
summary: Shua was a Canaanite man who was the father of Judah's wife. Through his daughter, he became the father-in-law of Judah, Jacob's son. He is mentioned in connection with Judah's marriage and family history in Genesis.

keyEvents.title: Judah's Marriage to Shua's Daughter
keyEvents.description: Judah saw the daughter of the Canaanite man Shua and took her as his wife. This marriage took place when Judah had left his brothers and settled near a man in Adullam.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Er
keyEvents.description: Shua's daughter bore Judah a son who was named Er. He was Judah's firstborn son.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Onan
keyEvents.description: Shua's daughter then bore another son to Judah, who was named Onan.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Shelah
keyEvents.description: Shua's daughter bore yet another son, Shelah, while Judah was in Kezib.

keyEvents.title: Death of Shua's Daughter
keyEvents.description: Shua's daughter, Judah's wife, died after a time. After the period of mourning, Judah went up to his sheepshearers at Timnah.

keyEvents.title: Mention in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Shua is mentioned in the genealogy of 1 Chronicles as the father of Judah's wife, the Canaanite woman.
